title: DLSA Jalore Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 26 Para Legal Volunteer Posts
description: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA Jalore) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 26 Para Legal Volunteer posts. Candidates who have passed 10th can grab this chance and apply for the DLSA Jalore Notification 2026 .
